<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex73022023-09-261" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (49a5-49a7)"/>
        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5192"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi <abbr>pha rol</abbr> tu phyin pa'i man <abbr>ngag gi</abbr> <abbr>bstan bcos</abbr> mngon par <choice><corr>rtogs</corr><sic>stoGS</sic></choice> pa rgyan</rs> gyi <abbr>dka' 'grel</abbr> lung gi dpag bsam rgyas 'gyur gyi tshal</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni | yongs 'dzin du mas nye bar bskyangs shing | khyad par du rang dang gzhan gyi grub <abbr>pa'i</abbr> mtha' rgya mtsho'i <abbr>pha rol</abbr> du phyin <lb n="49a6"/> pa <abbr>rigs</abbr> pa dang grol bar smra ba'i yongs ba bsaM gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' rnyes pas | <choice><corr>'chad</corr><sic>'tshad</sic></choice> pa dang rtsod pa dang | rtsoM <abbr>pa'i</abbr> tshul la zla dang bral ba <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">gangs can</rs> gyi bka' <abbr>bzhi</abbr> 'dzin pa <abbr>gcig</abbr> po <abbr>nyid du</abbr> nges pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4074">brtson 'grus dpal</rs> gyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing | de nyid las chos 'di'i tshul la <abbr><choice><corr>blo</corr><sic>slo</sic></choice>'i</abbr> snang ba cung zad skyes pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5193">shAkya' <choice><corr>btsun</corr><sic>bcun</sic></choice> pa <lb n="49a7"/> pa <abbr>dkon mchog</abbr> <abbr>grags</abbr></rs> kyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5733">ston <abbr>pa'i</abbr> rgyal tshab daM pa rnams kyi <abbr>bzhugs</abbr> gnas dpal <abbr>sa skya</abbr>'i chos gra dang nye ba'i sa</rs>r sbyar ba re shig <abbr>rdzogs so</abbr> ||</seg></TEI>
